adaptations: fadada.config.ts: replace Nest ConfigService dependency with same get interface; provider default is fadada rather than mock.
New isolated ESignAccount/EnterpriseSeal/SealAuthority/SignaturePolicy/ESignApproval/FadadaTask models replace old platform entities.
FadadaESignGateway adapts provider/account/artifact responsibilities using original digest, request, HTTP and API classes unchanged.

PDF writer uses independent StoredFile storage; subscription renderer/model/types byte-identical. Handover renderer adapted to current checklist/evidence/manifestHash with real coordinates and embedded images.
All enterprise sealing requires active issuer mapping, authorizations, two distinct people and immutable review hash. Source policy/compiler/hash retained unchanged.
Only sequential customer then enterprise sealing is enabled for this platform; unsupported parallel policies fail closed.
Generic provider success does not establish real name, expired certificates are blocked, signed-state requires exact provider identities and archived PDF.

New strict contract-template adapter interpolates user-approved main contract/commercial schedule using immutable customer-confirmed commercialTerms and canonical billing data; retained renderer/model/types remain unchanged. Missing/unknown placeholders and incomplete handover facts are rejected.

Review attempts preserve rejected/expired evidence; schema007 replaces the unique business/policy key with an index and serialized active-attempt creation. Authorized distinct reviewers can reject a pending unused attempt.

Schema008 binds provider query results to identityVersion, current ciphertext digest, transaction/serial and a persistent verify/query lease. Stale workers cannot verify a replacement identity or clear a newer worker lease.

Expired in-flight tasks can request a fresh two-person authorization of the same PDF/coordinates/task/platform/seal. Approval transaction CAS switches only task.approvalId and records the prior approval; envelope and signer transactions stay unchanged.
